def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    # Step 1: Filter orders that were placed before or at seed_time
    orders = db["orders"]
    valid_orders = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time][["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]]

    if len(valid_orders) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)

    # Step 2: Join with order_items to get items in those orders
    oi = db["order_items"]
    oi = oi.merge(valid_orders, on="order_id", how="inner")
    oi.rename(columns={"order_purchase_timestamp": "ts"}, inplace=True)

    if len(oi) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)

    # Step 3: Filter reviews created before or at seed_time
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    reviews_before = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    reviews_agg = reviews_before.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        n_reviews=("review_score", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    oi = oi.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Step 4: Time-based features
    oi["days_diff"] = (seed_time - oi["ts"]).dt.days
    oi["last_7"]   = (oi["days_diff"] <= 7)   & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)
    oi["last_30"]  = (oi["days_diff"] <= 30)  & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)
    oi["last_60"]  = (oi["days_diff"] <= 60)  & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)
    oi["last_90"]  = (oi["days_diff"] <= 90)  & (oi["days_diff"] >= 0)

    # Step 5: Aggregate item-level features
    item_agg = oi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        n_items=("price", "count"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
        n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review=("avg_review", "mean"),
        n_reviews=("n_reviews", "sum"),
        cnt_last_7=("last_7", "sum"),
        cnt_last_30=("last_30", "sum"),
        cnt_last_60=("last_60", "sum"),
        cnt_last_90=("last_90", "sum"),
        last_order_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_order_ts=("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    # Recency features
    item_agg["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - item_agg["last_order_ts"]).dt.days
    item_agg["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - item_agg["first_order_ts"]).dt.days
    item_agg.drop(columns=["last_order_ts", "first_order_ts"], inplace=True)

    # Average items per order
    item_agg["avg_items_per_order"] = item_agg["n_items"] / item_agg["n_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    item_agg["avg_items_per_order"] = item_agg["avg_items_per_order"].fillna(0)

    # Step 6: Payment data filtered up to seed_time
    payments = db["payments"]
    payments_filtered = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]

    # Group payments by order
    pay_by_order = payments_filtered.groupby("order_id")["payment_value"].sum().reset_index()
    pay_by_order.rename(columns={"payment_value": "order_total_payment"}, inplace=True)

    # Map to products via order_items
    order_product_map = oi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    order_product_payment = order_product_map.merge(pay_by_order, on="order_id", how="left")

    pay_agg = order_product_payment.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_orders_with_payment=("order_total_payment", "count"),
        sum_order_payment=("order_total_payment", "sum"),
        avg_payment_per_order=("order_total_payment", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    # Final merge
    features = item_agg.merge(pay_agg, on="product_id", how="outer")
    features.set_index("product_id", inplace=True)

    # Reindex to requested entity_ids and fill missing values
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    return features
